candidate_responsibility: Package verified changes into bisectable commits, coherent versions, changelogs, credential checks, and PR metadata.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Package verified changes into bisectable commits, coherent versions, changelogs, credential checks, and PR metadata.
Accept only: Implemented and reviewed changes with fresh verification evidence.
Produce only: A safe, traceable, version-consistent change package and pull-request description.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: Implemented and reviewed changes with fresh verification evidence.
output_boundary: A safe, traceable, version-consistent change package and pull-request description.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 语义版本判定与自动自增规则：基于差异规模与特征信号分类版本级别（MICRO/PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR），结合状态机驱动写入; 可二分原子提交拆分规程：将差异按基础设施、模型与服务、控制器与视图、版本元数据的顺序分层拆解为独立可编译验证的原子提交; PR 标题版本前缀与文档同步强制不变式：PR/MR 标题强制遵循 v<NEW_VERSION> 前缀规范，且必须先派发文档同步子代理
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 测试与审查通过后的版本递增步骤; 多文件综合性功能发布时的代码提交组织; 创建或更新 PR/MR 的最终收尾阶段
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 3 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (rule=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.
